Amritsar Police Bust Cross-Border Smuggling Module, Seize Drugs and Arms

Amritsar rural police have arrested two individuals and claim to have busted a cross-border narcotics and illegal arms smuggling module. During the operation, authorities recovered 15 illegal pistols and 5 kilograms of heroin. Inspector General of Police (IGP) border range Gurpreet Singh Bhullar announced the development on Monday.
